## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, format, tests)
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test (offline: use the fake GitHub helpers, no network)
- [ ] If a rule changed: rationale and `limitations` are filled in, and the methodology impact is described below
- [ ] If an evidence id was added or renamed: `docs/evidence-schema.md` and `npm run schemas` are updated
- [ ] No wording that turns an indicator into a verdict ("safe", "secure", "AI-generated", "trustworthy")
